scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.validate: npm run build && streamdeck validate com.wow-deck.sdPlugin --no-update-check
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.wow-deck.sdPlugin --output dist --force --no-file-list --no-update-check
scripts.link: npm run build && streamdeck link com.wow-deck.sdPlugin
